annotations.title: imagepeek: strip an image's metadata (EXIF, GPS, XMP)

description: imagepeek: Strip an image's EXIF, GPS, XMP, IPTC and comment metadata. To read the metadata use image_metadata. Returns the image without EXIF (GPS included), XMP, IPTC, comments and text chunks: JPEG, PNG, WebP and GIF are stripped losslessly at the byte level (pixel data unchanged), TIFF, BMP, ICO and AVIF re-encoded; an EXIF rotation is baked into the pixels first unless `auto_orient` is false. The result is re-checked to hold no metadata; `removed` lists what went. Reads PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, TIFF, BMP, ICO and AVIF; other formats and images over 40 megapixels are refused (not charged). Output: base64 `data_base64`, without EXIF, GPS, XMP or IPTC; over 15 MB or 50 megapixels is a 413 (not charged). Images are not logged; a result is kept only with `output` "url" (24 h). Typically 0.5-2 s. Price: USD 0.002. Free: 3 imagepeek calls per IP per UTC day. Docs: https://tanod.dev/learn/strip-image-metadata-api.html

auto_orient.description: Bake a non-1 EXIF orientation into the pixels (re-encode).
auto_orient.title: Auto Orient

image_base64.description: The image as standard or url-safe base64 (at most 10 MB decoded; a data:image/...;base64, prefix is fine); or use url.
image_base64.title: Image Base64

keep_icc.description: Keep the ICC colour profile (default false: removed too).
keep_icc.title: Keep Icc

output.description: base64 (default): inline. url: stored for 24 hours; link, metadata.
output.title: Output

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the image (at most 10 MB; private, internal and IP-literal hosts are refused); or use image_base64.
url.title: Url
